description: Réseau urbain Le Passe Pont - communes de Couffouleux et de Rabastens is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. GTFS data (stops, lines, theoretical timetables...) of the urban network Le Passe Pont des communes de Couffouleux (81070) and Rabastens (81220). Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. The portal shows the English title as "Le Passe Pont urban network – municipalities of Couffouleux and Rabastens" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. Its keywords include transport, transport-en-commun, rabastens, bus, mobilite, ligne. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
